categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches Cap'n Proto mining definition (src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp), interfaces::Mining (src/interfaces/mining.h), and functional IPC mining tests (test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py).
categories.rationale: Resolves a data race on `m_block_template` between concurrent IPC worker threads when modifying and reading active templates (issue #36515). Protecting the template with a mutex and adding `getTotalFees()` directly supports the reliability and efficiency of external consumers using the node over IPC.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Mining', touches block template management in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp and the node's mining interface in src/node/miner.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data race where concurrent worker calls can race when `submitSolution()` modifies an active template while another call reads it (issue #36515). It also improves mining interface efficiency by providing `getTotalFees()` to avoid fetching and summing fee vectors across process boundaries.
